description: DIN-rail energy meters of the iEM3000 series with Modbus RTU: currents, voltages, powers, power factor, frequency, energies by phase and tariff, demand, input metering and overload alarm
source: Schneider Electric, iEM3000 series user manual, DOCA0005EN-12 (10/2019), chapter 'Communications via Modbus', Modbus register list

sources.title: iEM3000 series energy meters, user manual
sources.note: Modbus register list; data types and DATETIME format

notes: Schneider Electric iEM3000 series (this map was listed as Farnell IEM3100 / IEM3200, after the distributor). The Modbus models of the series share one register list; registers marked 'Not applicable' do not exist on the models named.

Addresses are the 'Address' column of the manual (0x0BB7 for register 3000), so this map uses address_base 0 with the hex addresses. The old map used the register numbers and was one address too high.
Function 03 reads the registers. R/WC registers are set with the command interface (requested command at 5250, parameters from 5252), not by writing them directly.
DATETIME values use 4 registers: word 1 year (b6:b0, 0-127 from 2000), word 2 month (b11:b8), weekday (b7:b5), day (b4:b0), word 3 hour (b12:b8), minute (b5:b0), word 4 milliseconds.
Int64 energies are in Wh or varh. The demand and energy registers from 40200 and 45100 repeat values of the main list as 32-bit floats.
